subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When the executor is invoked for review-only recovery, it shall require a `drive_round_id` and closed non-empty set of selected in-scope review-obligation IDs, exact-read only that selected frontier, perform at most the FR-35 attempt for each selected obligation, and reconcile every selected member before a clean terminal; IDs that are unknown, verified, out of scope, duplicated, or not pending shall fail the invocation closed without widening the scan. The unattended driver owns durable recovery counts/bounds and issues at most one such invocation per round; the executor shall never infer eligibility from exit code, scan unselected pending obligations, redispatch succeeded implementation, or report clean while any selected obligation remains pending.
rationale: the provider owns attempts but not driver spend/exhaustion; an unbounded scan defeats mixed eligible/exhausted recovery and creates N-sweep races
fit_criterion: multi-obligation fixtures prove one invocation/round, one attempt maximum per selected member, zero attempts for unselected/exhausted members, exact failure for empty/duplicate/unknown/verified/out-of-scope IDs, zero implementation activity, exit 1 while any selected member remains pending, and exit 0 only when every selected member verifies
